name: Active Directory
description: Manage Active Directory over LDAP: multiple AD connections, create/move/edit users, set and reset passwords, enable/lock/unlock, expiry dates, create/move/assign groups, create/move OUs and bulk import via CSV. Connected ADs can be picked directly as a sign-in source in the "SSO" module. New: edit DNS records of AD-integrated zones (A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, SRV, NS, PTR) and manage Group Policy (create, delete, rename, link, order, enforce, block inheritance, security filtering) plus edit it: ALL administrative templates are loaded dynamically from the domain's ADMX/ADML files, along with custom registry values and security settings. Agentless via LDAP + SYSVOL - or through a BYTERA node on the domain controller.
author: BYTERA
